EP1.rule: endpoint MC-SE <= 0.05 x final interval width, both endpoints

outer_resampling.mandatory_description: conditional on the observed 136 recurrence events and 316 censored observations in the 452-patient A-19 population

intervals.BCa: EXCLUDED unless an independently defensible acceleration estimate exists

revision_A_inner_failures.v2_0_rule_withdrawn: exclude failures below 5% and continue (assumed ignorable)
revision_A_inner_failures.why: fits fail on STRAINED resamples, plausibly those with the LARGEST optimism; excluding them biases optimism down and corrected C UP -- the optimistic direction. M2 is likelier to fail than M1, which would break the pairing.
revision_A_inner_failures.pairing_preserving_exclusion: if EITHER model fails at inner replicate b, BOTH are excluded; opt_M1 and opt_M2 are always averaged over the identical set
revision_A_inner_failures.representativeness_test: compare failed vs successful inner replicates on the recorded covariates; cross-tabulate failures by model and by outer replicate to detect concentration
revision_A_inner_failures.bounding_analysis: recompute DeltaC_corr(k) with missing paired optimism imputed at the observed MIN and MAX within that outer replicate; recompute the whole interval under both
revision_A_inner_failures.decision_rule: both endpoints move < endpoint MC-SE -> failures demonstrably non-influential, primary interval stands with bounds reported; otherwise interval labelled UNRELIABLE REGARDLESS of how far below 5% the failure rate is
revision_A_inner_failures.five_percent_status: WARNING BOUNDARY ONLY -- never licenses an ignorability assumption
revision_A_inner_failures.precedent: 0/7500 inner failures in both completed runs

A7.name: percentile vs basic
A7.statistical_justification: NONE -- a visibility heuristic; the direction of the comparison is informative, the cut-point is not
A7.standing: WARNING W6 -- investigate and report; neither validates nor invalidates

A8.name: |z0|
A8.statistical_justification: PARTIAL -- SE(z0)=sqrt(p(1-p)/B)/phi(z0) = 0.056 at B_out=500 and 0.025 pooled over 5 runs, so 0.25 is ~4.5 SE (single) / ~10 SE (pooled); a LOOSE DETECTION boundary, not a validity criterion

resampling_audit.optimism_evaluated_on: D*_k (the outer sample), NOT the original D
resampling_audit.pairing: one index array per layer, shared by M1 and M2, multiplicities included
refit_every_fit_no_caching: M2-A2 score standardisation incl. zero-variance <=1e-12 and non-finite handling
ridge lambda via the frozen nested 5-fold CV (P6B-A1)
model fit, convergence and separation checks
resampling_audit.c_index: Harrell via lifelines concordance_index, frozen -lp orientation, Efron ties

rng_policy.why_not: reusing [20261102..20261106] for the OUTER layer would make new outer resamples the same index sequences as the old inner resamples, creating unintended dependence
rng_policy.hierarchy: SeedSequence([BASE, run_id]) -> spawn(B_out) -> spawn(B_in) -> spawn(2) for CV
properties: scheduling-invariant (stream is a pure function of (BASE,run_id,k,b))
rng_policy.multiplicities: index arrays with repeats; full 452-length multiplicity vector stored per outer replicate
rng_policy.reproducibility_check: 20 fixed outer indices of run 0 recomputed; must match BIT-IDENTICALLY

endpoint_stability.kernel_method: Gaussian KDE, Silverman bandwidth, recomputed at bandwidth x {0.5,1.0,2.0}
endpoint_stability.five_run_limitation: df=4, relative SE of the SD ~35%; agreement between kernel and empirical estimators is CONSISTENCY, not validation -- both assume within-run iid draws

EP1_failure_rule.method: top up each run from the SAME SeedSequence spawn list at indices B_out..B_out'-1
EP1_failure_rule.never: narrow, re-centre or re-quantile the interval to satisfy EP-1

computational_plan.checkpoint: run{id}_outer.jsonl, one flushed line per completed outer replicate; resume skips completed k; resumed run is bit-identical

hard_failures.H2: bounding moves an endpoint > endpoint MC-SE -> UNRELIABLE
hard_failures.H3: EP-1 unmet after the B_out ladder -> label IMPRECISE
hard_failures.H6: paired-complete inner counts differ between M1 and M2 -> abort (implementation defect)

warnings.W2: failures concentrated in one model or few outer replicates
warnings.W3: inner SD inflation >5% -> raise B_in, never deconvolve
warnings.W5: MC-1 endpoint trace spread > EP-1 bound -> raise B_out

unresolved_limitations: bootstrap validity asymptotic at n=452, non-smooth statistic, internal tuning
distinct-patient dilution: inner fits see ~181/452 (40%) distinct patients; direction of the resulting bias is predicted (negative z0) but its magnitude is not estimable from this design
between-run SD rests on 5 observations (df=4, ~35% relative SE)
A7 threshold has no statistical justification
A8 passing does not establish absence of median bias
inner-noise SD inflation ~1.2% documented, not removed
Harrell C is censoring-distribution dependent, not transportable
molecular block penalised, clinical not -- conservative by design, NOT an unbiased estimate of the molecular contribution
internal validation only; U1 unresolved so no fixed-time or absolute-risk claim
recommendation: READY FOR EXECUTION pending explicit authorisation
